# Close wrap, Fri Oct 16, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:25 PM ET)

**Tone: AI-debt/chip rout resumed into opex; oil spike (Brent $110) adds pressure. Defensives, energy, banks held up. Nasdaq's worst week since June.**

1. **Indexes:** S&P 500 −1.1% (7,659), Nasdaq −2.1% (26,140), Dow −0.3% (52,002). Week: S&P −1.95%, Nasdaq −4.5%, Dow +0.7%. VIX ~20.1 (+22%). ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-c27809783ae3230b44c26e5ee4bea056), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-futures-mixed-amid-volatile-week-112939401.html), box yfinance)
2. **Why:** debt-funded AI infra doubts as borrowing costs rise; CRWV −11.9%, AVGO −4.5%, chip index 8th straight down day (SOXX −4.1%, AMD −6%, MU −5.6%). Comms −2.5% and tech −2.4% led losses. ([Reuters via StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/Market+Check/Wall+Street+tumbles+as+worries+about+AI+trade+and+high+oil+prices+weigh/27195576.html), [X](https://x.com/i/trending/2111188265642426396))
3. **Oil:** Brent touched $110 (first since May) as Iran escalated in Hormuz; box Brent $109.6, WTI $98.9. XLE +2.5%, XOM +2.5%; airlines UAL −5.1%, DAL −3.5%. ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-futures-mixed-amid-volatile-week-112939401.html))
4. **Covered:** BLK +1.2%, WMT +0.8%, JPM +1.3%, AMT +2.2%, CCI +2.8%; UNH −1.3%; META −3.7%, TSLA −2.1% (Roadster pop faded), NFLX −2.9%. Optics: COHR −7.1%, CIEN −6.7%, LITE −5.2%. ([CNBC midday](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/16/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-crwv-moga-jbht-aa.html), box yfinance)
5. **After hours:** quiet Friday; no covered reports. 10y ~5.10%.

**Next week:** NFLX 10/20 AMC; TSLA/IBM/META 10/21 AMC; AAL 10/22; FOMC 10/28.

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **BLK**: green again on a −1.1% tape; record AUM/inflows. Conf: med. Risk: equity drawdown hits fees.
- **WMT**: DB Buy + staples bid (XLP +1.1%, +5% wk). Conf: low. Risk: crowded defensive trade unwinds if tech rebounds.
- **XLP**: rotation into staples as oil/inflation bite. Conf: low. Risk: rotation snaps back.

**Avoid:** airlines; AI optics; semis/memory group; CRWV/ORCL/NBIS/IREN (AI debt); BAC.

## Weekly scorecard (Quality Desk)
Calls 10/14–10/16, marked to Fri close: **9 up, 4 down, 3 flat (±0.5%)** — 56% raw, 69% of decided. SPY −2.0% wk. Best: BLK (+4.2% from 10/14 open), UNH (+5.0% from 10/14 open), XLV (+1.6%). Misses: ASML (−2.1%), WMT 10/15 open (−1.0%), UNH late re-adds (−1.3%, −2.2%). Older 10/09 swings: AMT +1.7%, CCI +3.3%, LITE −25.3% (moved to avoid 10/16).
Paper desk: swing account weekly check **FAIL** (weekly.csv: $19,956.99 vs $20,019.75 baseline, −0.3%); daily.csv shows −2.1% today vs bench −1.2%, heavy core QQQ weight. Two files disagree on close equity — flag for Tendies and Dip.
